items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Walter Johnson and I went with Robert -- Bobby Brown... Walter and I used to commute over to Newark... Walter was on drum.

ctx.x: That must have been a fairly good job for those days.

Yes, it was. We stayed there for about, oh, I think about four or five years. They sent for me when I was in New Jersey working in Newark, and they sent for me (unintelligible) but I'm doing good and liked the East too (unintelligible) and living in New York and working over in Newark. Rex Stewart and myself, we were good buddies, Walter Johnson (unintelligible) going.
Well, when you -- just back to that record. You did record (unintelligible) in '23. with Bernie Young (unintelligible) then) (unintelligible)
